apps.name: BCD
apps.localizedDescription: BCD: Windows games on iPhone and iPad. Steam and GOG built in.
apps.subtitle: BCD: Windows games on iPhone and iPad. Steam and GOG built…

versions.localizedDescription:
BCD is in alpha: an early stage of development, before beta. Many games run, many do not yet, and things can break between builds. When a game fails, please send a log.

Everything new in this release is experimental and has been tried on only a few devices so far. It may work great on yours, or it may not work at all. Either way, a log helps a lot.

Tried a game on an earlier build? Reset its settings first. On the game's page: Options › Recommended settings › Reset to Recommended. The recommended list changed for 78 games in this release.

This build brings everything since 0.1.686: X-Plane 12 getting further, frame generation and an FPS counter for Vulkan games, Valve's November 2026 Steam client for BCD Dock, an experimental Steam for Windows, new pages in Settings, a round of fixes from the logs you sent, and a fix for Epic games on an external drive.

X-Plane 12 (experimental)

X-Plane 12 gets further than before. On one iPhone it loaded, drew its cockpit and flew for six minutes. It is slow, it has been tried on that one iPhone only, and it is still experimental.

• What you need: iOS 26 or later and a device with a Metal 4 GPU. Start the game from your Steam library through BCD Dock, the way it was tried. On the game's page choose Options › Recommended settings › Reset to Recommended. The recommended settings carry everything below.
• Lowest graphics settings (new): the recommended settings now carry xplane-graphics = lowest.
• Why: X-Plane saves its preferences only when it quits cleanly, and it never had. So every start took X-Plane's default settings and went straight into its first-time flight, with no main menu to lower them in. At those defaults the game stopped twice with "X-Plane is totally out of memory" and "Failed to allocate a GPU buffer", each time with BCD's address space full.
• What it does: before X-Plane starts, BCD sets the default of each of its 14 graphics settings, in X-Plane's own Resources/settings.txt, to the lowest value. X-Plane's safe mode and every other byte of the file stay as they were. What you save in X-Plane still wins over these defaults.
• Going back: X-Plane's own file is kept as settings.txt.bcd-original and put back when the line is removed.
• A 4 GB swap file (new): the recommended settings now carry swap-mb = 4096, swap-mode = 2 and swap-min-mb = 1. BCD then moves game data to a file on the device's storage when memory runs short. Without it iOS ended the app at its 8 GB limit while the flight loaded (5 GB at the menu, 8.1 GB three minutes later). With it the flight ran for six minutes at a peak of 6.8 GB, and X-Plane quit cleanly from its own menu.
• A freeze while loading: one log showed the game compiling about 700 shader libraries over eight minutes. Then one more compile, a Metal library with no shader source, was still running 96 seconds later, and the game never drew again. BCD now refuses such a request at once instead of sending it to Metal's compiler. This was checked on a Mac. On the iPhone the next run took every shader from the cache, so the refusal itself has not been seen working there yet.
• FPS counter: it never worked for X-Plane, because Vulkan games did not reach it. It does now (see below).
• What to expect: about 13 to 18 FPS in flight at the lowest settings. The first start compiles shaders for several minutes (about 700 compiles over eight minutes in one log); later starts read them from the cache.
• With frame generation (below) X-Plane reached about 35 FPS shown in flight on that iPhone, from about 15 of its own (the HUD's 15+15). iPads and other iPhones have not been tried. If it fails on yours, please send a log.

Frame generation and the FPS counter for Vulkan games (experimental)…

apps.name: Andarium
apps.localizedDescription: Run real Linux kernel natively on iOS

versions.localizedDescription:
What's new
• Root access: apps you allow in Magisk can now run as root. Turn on Root access on Home, and the next start installs the official Magisk app.
• AOT: Android's system libraries now run from code translated ahead of time, so Android runs faster. It is on by default, in Performance on Home.
• 120 Hz: on a ProMotion iPhone or iPad, Android can now run at 120 Hz for smoother motion, using more battery. It is off until you turn it on in Performance on Home.
• Add to Home Screen: on iPhone and iPad with iOS 27, put an Android app's icon on the Home Screen, and open the app from there, from Shortcuts or with Siri.
• VoiceOver and TalkBack: Andarium now works with VoiceOver. To hear Android's screen, turn on TalkBack under Accessibility.
• Frame rate when hot: Android now lowers the frame rate only when the device is very hot. To keep it even then, set When hot to Full frame rate under Performance.
• Text messages: Android can now receive a text message that you write. Choose Send text message… in Settings while Android is running, and it arrives as an incoming text.
• Update notice: when a newer version is out, Home tells you and shows how to update. It checks once a day, and you can turn it off in Info.
• iOS 26: the app now runs on iOS 26 or later.
• Fixes:
• Fixed the virtual machine's Wi-Fi dropping briefly when you return to Andarium
• Fixed face scans failing in some apps that use the front camera
• Fixed connections hanging after the device moves from Wi-Fi to cellular data
• Fixed apps failing to reach servers for a while after the network returns
• VP9 videos now play with the device's hardware decoder

Sideloading
You can sideload the app with AltStore or SideStore.

The easy way is to add the source, so updates show up in AltStore or SideStore:

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/imxieyi/Kernarium/main/sideload/source.json

Alternatively, install the IPA by hand:

1. Download Andarium-1.1-16.ipa on the device. It's about 1 GB.
2. Open AltStore or SideStore, tap + in My Apps and pick the IPA.

A few things to know:

• iOS 26 or later is required.
• The app uses the Increased Memory Limit and Extended Virtual Addressing entitlements.
• A free Apple ID works, but the app expires after 7 days and must be refreshed in AltStore or SideStore.
• With a free Apple ID, Android gets less memory. AltStore 2.2 or later keeps the increased memory limit, SideStore doesn't by default. Extended virtual addressing needs a paid developer account.
• JIT is optional and experimental. To use it, assign the universal script to Andarium in StikDebug once, then open Andarium from StikDebug.
• To update by hand, install the new IPA with the same Apple ID and the same tool. It replaces the old version and keeps your virtual machine.

Prebuilt artifacts
• android-6.18-…-ca1.tar.gz: the accepted Android kernel bundle. Extract it into .build/kernel/artifacts/.
• lineage24-…-r29.tar.gz: the accepted Android system release.
• lineage24-…-r29-aot.tar.gz: the AOT artifact of that release. Extract both anywhere, then run android/lineage-24/tools/install-release.py --source <dir>/lineage24-mainline6.18-4k-20261121-los24-r29 --aot-artifact <dir>/lineage24-mainline6.18-4k-20261121-los24-r29-aot.

apps.localizedDescription: File browser, app data manager and cache cleaner for iOS 26 and 27 (worse_query, no jailbreak)
apps.subtitle: File browser, app data manager and cache cleaner for iOS 26…

versions.localizedDescription:
Requires: iOS 26.0 – 26.7.2, or iOS 27.0 up to 27.3 beta 1. Not supported: iOS 27.3 beta 2 and later, where Apple patched worse_query. Tested on iOS 27.0.1, 27.2.1, 27.3 beta 1 (confirmed by a user) and 26.7.1; see Tested devices.
Needs: a sideloading tool that keeps the App Group entitlement; see Signing in the README.

Worse Query Files 0.9.20

Apps Manager backups, and safer handling of databases that are in use.

New

• Import Apps Manager backups (#19): Apps → tap the app → Import as Backup… now accepts .adbk files from Apps Manager. The app's data is saved as a normal WQ Files backup, ready to restore.
• Only the app's own data folder is imported. App Group data in the file isn't, because WQ Files backups don't include App Groups. The keychain items Apps Manager saves are encrypted, so they can't be imported either. When you import, WQ Files lists what it left out.
• If the file says it belongs to a different app than the one you tapped, WQ Files asks first, as with any other import.
• Opening an .adbk from the Files app or the share sheet doesn't start an import; start it from Apps.

Fixed

• Files another app is using: deleting or replacing them, for example an app's database in its App Group while the app runs, failed with "Resource temporarily unavailable (errno 35)". WQ Files now says another app is using the file and that quitting that app and trying again should work. Its extensions or widgets can keep the file open even after you quit it.
• Databases in use stay intact: an app's database comes with -wal and -shm files next to it, and while the app runs, iOS doesn't lock the -wal file. WQ Files could delete or replace it while refusing the database file, which lost the app's newest data. Now a database and its -wal, -shm and -journal files are only changed together: if one of them is in use, none of them is touched. This applies to deleting (also whole folders), replacing on import and editing.
• Deleting or importing several files at once: each database is handled before its -wal and -shm files, which are skipped if the database itself couldn't be deleted or replaced. "N of M files were imported" is translated now.

Credit

New design: GpGp700. Sandbox technique: worse_query by Taj C (forcequit). Container enumeration: KAMUI by murk-sus. Resumable scans: hhh2210. Custom inspectors idea: deltaII. Translations: iosrxwy and FrogTool (Simplified Chinese), kinboy56 (Japanese), hfip (Arabic), hooray804 (Korean), Reinascape (Russian), romlayvn-93 (Vietnamese), buraakkcayir (Turkish review). Thanks to braless for the Apps Manager sample, and to everyone who sent screenshots and Logs. GPL-3.0-or-later.

Welcome to OpenParsec v2.0.0!

This is the release promised back in 1.4.0, with everything that's been on the nightly since october.

We now have a Metal renderer, streams that hold and reconnect by themselves, new connecting screens,reworked settings, and other control-related improvements.

Before you update:
• auto reconnect is now switched on by default, see settings > developer for additional settings
• everyone is now on the new Metal renderer. OpenGL is remains optional as a fallback\
• this is the last release for ios 14. it runs with some rough edges but remains functional. Future releases will be pinned, and we plan to require ios 15 starting from the next release. A seperate branch for iOS 14 will be created for backporting fixes as maintainer time allows

streaming
• metal renderer, now the default (#118)
• 120hz on ProMotion iphones (#118)
• the stream stays connected in the background for as long as ios allows, and reconnects when you're back (#138)
• the last frame stays up when the stream drops (#138)
• auto reconnect waits for the network to come back, and reconnects right away on a wifi/cellular switch (#138)
• resolution, bitrate and constant frame rate survive a reconnect (#119)

input
• smoother trackpad scrolling, thanks @alantangok (#97)
• reverse scrolling works for trackpad and mouse, thanks @MoustacheOff (#116)
• menu edge swipe setting, thanks @alantangok (#100)

• show menu button off no longer hides the keyboard button (#120)
• mouse side buttons (#120)
• drag handle in direct mode when the keyboard covers the picture, three finger tap hides the keyboard (#120)
• the next controller takes over when the active one disconnects (#120)

app
• settings rework, and settings open from the stream menu (#119, #129)
• bitrate, constant frame rate and pinch to zoom are settings that carry over between streams (#119)
• touch mode in the stream menu (#129)
• connecting and reconnect screens match and show a live connection log (#130)
• says right away when there's no network, retries once if the host doesn't answer (#117)
• last host card stays after a disconnect, reconnect from the app icon (#117)
• host list refresh no longer blocks the screen, long press a host to copy its name (#113)
• new readme, contributing guide and issue templates (#139)

Thanks to everyone for making bug reports on nightly builds, and thank you for your support!

RewindBox 0.0.11 — Build 721

Everything since RewindBox 0.0.10 (Build 559), brought together in one update.

🎮 PlayStation 3 — RPCS3

• Assassin’s Creed: audio mixing corrections prevent audio periods from being discarded during waits.
• Reduced redundant rendering interruptions and repeated graphics work, including changes to Vulkan/MoltenVK.
• Improved texture caching to reuse more previously calculated results.
• Black Ops II: corrections to SPU synchronization, memory reservations and waits involved in stalls.
• Black Ops II: earlier submission of pending occlusion results, with a separate bounded budget, targets waits on the game’s main CPU threads.
• Corrected short active-wait timing on iPhones with a 1 GHz system counter and adjusted the BO2 writer-lock wait path.
• Assassin’s Creed: corrected an atomic SPU write that could overwrite a newer main-CPU value during game exit.
• Improved SPU program preparation and cache reuse to reduce recompilation during gameplay.
• God of War III: removed the unintended 30 FPS limit and reduced unnecessary texture validation.
• God of War III v1.00: the optional MLAA bypass now applies on a fresh boot as well.
• Assassin’s Creed IV and Dynasty Warriors 6: corrected game profiles to use the LLVM PPU recompiler.
• Corrected texture coherence, partial graphics commands and CPU/GPU synchronization paths.
• More reliable retention of mounted ISO images.
• Corrected JIT memory reservation when the usual address range is unavailable, including on certain iOS beta versions.
• Repositioned the Menu and Performance buttons to better respect touch controls and safe areas.
• Expanded per-game settings and diagnostic tools to identify the causes of stalls more precisely.

🕹️ Nintendo Switch — MeloNX

• Support for the keyboard requested by games, plus touch access to L3/R3.
• Corrected controller handling during sessions and when returning to the interface.
• First-frame and GPU-transfer corrections targeting black screens at launch.
• Graphics ordering corrections targeting stale frames, flickering and rendering artifacts.
• Corrected shader resource declarations and compilation paths that could prevent parts of a scene from rendering.
• JIT corrections covering branches, translation-block boundaries and register-state preservation.
• Fewer repeated allocations, improved texture reuse and release of resources no longer needed.
• Improved memory-pressure handling and cleanup of resources retained after closing a session.
• More durable shader and pipeline caches: saves during gameplay and on pause, background loading and improved reuse between sessions.
• Preparation of previously encountered graphics variants to reduce their reconstruction during gameplay.
• Reduced redundant graphics-resource updates and improved sharing of Metal libraries between compilation workers.
• Hogwarts Legacy corrections covering texture copies and handling of certain invalid graphics values.
• Failure to start the iOS audio engine no longer directly aborts the application.
• Compilation cancellation during teardown addresses sessions stuck on “closing,” including the SSBU path.
• Corrected a MoltenVK presentation ownership race: an in-flight presentation retains the drawable it needs.
• Added a fragmentation guard to avoid unnecessary blocking memory cleanup, targeting pauses reproduced from Super Smash Bros. Ultimate logs.

🎨 Skins and touch controls

• Added GameCube Pocket, Wii Pocket and PS2 Pocket skins.
• Added Pocket — Original variants for GameCube, Wii and PS2 while keeping the existing designs.
• Added Switch Pocket, available through Skins in the Switch playlist menu.
• Portrait and landscape layouts, with orientation locking where supported by the selected skin and engine.
• Corrected offsets between the drawn buttons and their touch areas.
• Corrected rectangular press highlights, pressed states and analog-stick geometry.
• GameCube/Wii analog sticks now move as a complete circle, including the C-stick.…

A manga and webtoon reader for your Suwayomi server.

✨ New Features

• Added Up and Down page turns in horizontal paged mode and N and P to change chapter (@aaronbamblett)

🚀 Improvements

• Moved Create registration code to Manage users and added an Edit button to user rows (@aaronbamblett)

🧩 Fixes

• Fixed the offline library not opening when Tsumiru starts without a connection (@aaronbamblett)
• Fixed Something went wrong showing on every page while reading offline (@aaronbamblett)
• Fixed library covers going blank in Safari after scrolling them off screen and back (@aaronbamblett)
• Fixed the paged reader restoring an old zoom when you return to a page (@aaronbamblett)
• Fixed saved searches from older WebUI versions not loading (@aaronbamblett)

Thanks to our Weblate translators: Damien O'Neil for French, Kisnov for Catalan, Andrei Stepanov for Russian and PainTownblue for Chinese.

Install

You'll need a running Suwayomi server. See Getting started.

Mobile

Android: download the universal APK below and open it to install. Smaller APKs for specific chip types are also attached.

iOS: the …-ios.ipa below is unsigned and has to be sideloaded. Add https://tsumiru.app/apps.json as a source in SideStore or AltStore to install it and get later releases as updates.

<details>
<summary>Which sideloading tool should I use?</summary>

• SideStore signs and refreshes the app on the device itself, with no computer needed after setup. Best for most people.
• AltStore expires every 7 days and only refreshes while a computer running AltServer is switched on and on the same Wi-Fi as your phone.
• TrollStore installs permanently with no expiry, but only works on older iPhones and iOS versions with the required vulnerability.

With SideStore or AltStore the app is re-signed periodically, which those tools automate. There is no App Store build.
</details>

Desktop

Windows: download …-windows-x64.zip, extract it anywhere, and run tsumiru.exe.

macOS: download …-macos-universal.zip, extract it, and move the app to Applications. If macOS blocks the first launch, approve it under System Settings → Privacy & Security.

Linux: the Flatpak is recommended and auto-updates.

flatpak remote-add --if-not-exists tsumiru https://flatpak.tsumiru.app/index.flatpakrepo
flatpak install tsumiru app.tsumiru.Tsumiru

Existing Flatpak installs keep receiving updates under io.github.aaronbamblett.tsumiru; no data, settings or logins move. AppImage/deb also keep that ID.

For a portable option, download …-linux-x86_64.AppImage, mark it executable with chmod +x, and run it.

Web

Download …-web.zip and serve its contents with any static web server.

versions.localizedDescription:
Unsigned build — sign it with your own Apple ID before installing.
https://github.com/ResistanceTo/MiniWatts#install

改进

• 温度可以显示为华氏度。 设置 → 单位 里可选"自动 / °C / °F"。"自动"跟随系统地区，以及"设置 › 通用 › 语言与地区"里的"温度"选项，所以地区使用华氏度的用户升级后会直接看到 °F。App 各页、图表、热力图、悬浮读数、实时活动和小组件都按所选单位显示；原始数据仍显示传感器给出的 °C。(#25)
• 充电预估。 充电时，功率页会显示充到 80% 和充到 100% 还要多久，以及大约几点。时间根据电量实际上升的速度推算，不依赖电池能量设置；要等电量变化两次才会出现，通常需要几分钟。80% 以后按典型充电曲线估算，只是近似值。(#27)
• 显示版本号。 设置 → 关于 里显示当前版本，原始数据导出的第一行也带上了版本号。(#27)
• iPad 布局。 iPad 横屏和 13 英寸竖屏时，各页分成两栏；窄屏时仍是一栏。历史记录里单次充电的详情页在 iPad 上不再横向铺满。(#22)
• iPad 热力图。 在 iPad 上，发热页画的是 iPad 的轮廓，各区域按 iPad Pro 11 英寸的内部布局放置：主板在中间，两侧是电芯，充电芯片在 USB-C 接口旁。设备页和设置里的图标也换成了 iPad。(#13, #22)

修复

• 发热：CPU 簇（pACC、eACC）和图像处理器（ISP）等传感器以前被归入"其他传感器"，现在算作 SoC，SoC 区域的温度也会把它们算进去。iPhone 11 上 FrontCameraDie、BCMLBSkin 这类名字连写的传感器以前会被分错区（比如前摄像头被当成机身），现在会先拆词再归类。(#13, #14)
• 适配器页里"单次采样"那段说明以前在中文界面下一直显示英文，现在已有中文。

注意

• iPad 相关的改动只在模拟器里验证过，我手上没有 iPad。如果在 iPad 上看到问题，请从 设置 → 原始数据 复制导出并反馈。
• iPad 上"来自充电器"的功率偏低（#13）这次还没有修：要确认其余的输入由哪个传感器测量，需要一份充电时导出的原始数据。有 iPad 的话，请在充电时从 设置 → 原始数据 复制导出，贴到 #13。
• 充电预估无法知道是否开启了充电上限或优化电池充电。如果开着，电池会在上限前停下，"充到 100%"的时间就不准。

Improvements

• Temperatures can be shown in Fahrenheit. Settings → Units offers Automatic, °C or °F. Automatic follows your region and the Temperature option under Settings › General › Language & Region, so if your region uses Fahrenheit you will see °F straight after updating. Every page, the charts, the heat map, the floating meter, the Live Activity and the widget follow the setting; Raw data still shows the sensors' own °C. (#25)
• Charge forecast. While charging, the Power page shows how long until 80% and until 100%, and roughly when. It is worked out from how fast the battery level is actually rising, so it does not depend on the battery energy setting; it appears once the level has moved twice, usually within a few minutes. Past 80% it follows a typical charging curve and is approximate. (#27)
• Version number. Settings → About shows the installed version, and the first line of the Raw data dump includes it. (#27)
• iPad layout. On an iPad in landscape, and a 13-inch in portrait, every page uses two columns; narrower windows keep one. A session's detail page in History no longer stretches edge to edge on an iPad. (#22)
• iPad heat map. On an iPad the Thermal page draws an iPad, with the zones placed as in an iPad Pro 11-inch: logic board down the middle, a battery cell either side, the charge IC by the USB-C port. The Devices page and Settings use iPad icons too. (#13, #22)

Fixes

• Thermal: the CPU-cluster (pACC, eACC) and image-processor (ISP) sensors used to land under "Other sensors"; they now count as the SoC, and the SoC zone's temperature includes them. On an iPhone 11, run-together sensor names such as FrontCameraDie and BCMLBSkin were filed in the wrong zone (the front camera as chassis); names are now split into words before they are matched. (#13, #14)
• Adapter: the one-sample note always showed in English in the Chinese interface; it is now translated.

Notes

• The iPad changes were checked in the simulator only — I do not have an iPad. If something looks wrong on yours, copy the dump from Settings → Raw data and report it.
• The low "from charger" reading on an iPad (#13) is not fixed yet: finding which sensor carries the rest of the input needs a Raw data dump taken while charging. If you have an iPad, please copy one from Settings → Raw data while it charges and post it on #13.
• The charge forecast cannot tell whether a charge limit or Optimized Battery Charging is on. If one is, the battery stops short and the time to 100% will be wrong.

Important: accounts now need your own Firebase project

SceneBox no longer connects to a shared Firebase project. Sign-in, profiles and sync between devices now run on a free Firebase project that you create and own. Your data stays in your own account, not mine.

• Guest mode still works without any setup. Everything is kept on the device.

• Accounts made on the old shared project don't carry over. Create a new account on your own project.
• Profile photos need Firebase Storage, which requires Google's Blaze plan (it has a free tier). Everything else works on the free Spark plan.

New

• Support SceneBox page in Settings, for anyone who wants to donate.

Fixes

• Downloading a second episode from a season pack works now. Before, every episode of a pack counted as the same download, so you had to delete the finished one before the next would start. (#9)
• Apple TV: Trakt lists open when you click them. (#10)
• Mac: signing in works on the unsigned build. macOS doesn't let unsigned apps use the Keychain, so the app keeps your sign-in session and any API keys you enter in a file inside its own sandbox container instead (readable only by your user account).

Still open

• A few people report that on iPhone the app closes shortly after a stream starts buffering. I can't reproduce it on the simulator or on Mac. If it hits you, please share the crash log: Settings > Privacy & Security > Analytics & Improvements > Analytics Data, look for a file starting with SceneBox, and attach it to the issue. Also say which iPhone and what you were playing (torrent or debrid, resolution). 1.0.2 doesn't have this problem if you need a fallback.
• Apple TV install failing in Sideloadly with "ApplicationVerificationFailed / Invalid file" on tvOS 26.6 (#8). The tvOS build is packaged exactly like 1.0.2 and passes Apple's bundle verification here, so this needs the full Sideloadly log: the "Invalid file" line names the file it choked on. Please paste that on the issue. Sideloadly also has known trouble with tvOS 26.4 and later (pairing), so try the latest Sideloadly first.

Important: this release is NOT signed. You have to allow it yourself.

Nothing here is signed with an Apple developer account and the Mac app is not notarized. macOS and iOS will refuse to open it until you explicitly allow it. This is expected, it's not broken.

Mac:

1. Open the dmg and drag SceneBox to Applications.
2. Open SceneBox. macOS will say it "could not verify" the app or that it's from an unidentified developer. Press Done (not Move to Trash).
3. Go to System Settings > Privacy & Security, scroll down to Security and press "Open Anyway" next to SceneBox, then confirm.
4. From then on it opens normally.

If you'd rather skip the dialog, run this in Terminal after copying the app to Applications:

xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/SceneBox.app

If you had an older signed version installed, delete it first.

iPhone/iPad: the ipa isn't signed, you sign it yourself with Sideloadly, AltStore, SideStore, Feather or ESign with your own Apple ID. Free Apple ID = resign every 7 days (AltStore/SideStore do it for you), paid dev account = one year.

Apple TV: Sideloadly works over Wi-Fi. On the TV go to Settings > Remotes and Devices > Remote App and Devices so it shows up, then pick it in Sideloadly.

若您在启动游戏时遇到闪退、黑屏、直接崩溃等问题，请更新至该版本。
同时新增 AI 助手、启动时自动检查更新等功能。26.2 与 26.3 都可以正常使用,请悉知.

更新内容
• 新增 AI 助手:可以和你对话,也能帮你找资源、装模组/整合包/光影,还能读取游戏日志、分析崩溃原因 @herbrine8403
• 新增 启动时自动检查更新:有新版本会自动提示,并显示可滚动的更新说明 @yitenchen123
• 适配 Minecraft 26.3(SDL3 窗口/输入/呈现层):修复进入游戏黑屏、画面缩在角落、小窗显示错位、Vulkan 下帧率一直显示为 0、物品栏点不动、快捷栏按键错位等问题 @yitenchen123 @Gsjsjzhznsz @herbrine8403
• 修复 MobileGlues 渲染器在 26.3 下闪退的深层原因 @yiyeshi0-hash
• 支持 Metal(metallum)渲染器,可用于 Minecraft 26.2 / 26.3 @yiyeshi0-hash
• 新增 MobileGL / MobileGL-gles 渲染器,并新增 SimpleFPEWrapper(sfpew) 以支持 1.17 及以下版本(请在设置中开启 sfpew,并在渲染器中选择 MobileGL-gles);同时修复 MobileGlues 在 26.3 下的闪退与黑屏 @yitenchen123
• MobileGlues 内置源码升级到上游 2.0.x,着色器转换链不再互相干扰 @yitenchen123
• 引入 LWJGL 3.3.3 / 3.4.1 两套运行库看，可按游戏版本自动选择或手动选择 @yitenchen123 @herbrine8403
• 修复 Forge / NeoForge 直装时的启动器被关闭、直装后闪退、模块冲突等问题 @yiyeshi0-hash @yitenchen123
• 修复 OptiFine 直装、整合包导入,以及下载源和镜像相关的报错 @yitenchen123
• 修复 JIT 相关问题:开启 JIT 后启动不再闪退(含使用外部 JIT 后启动闪退的情况),并新增 JIT 工具选择 @herbrine8403 @yiyeshi0-hash
• 优化内存占用:自动识别大内存权限,减少后台内存回收导致的闪退 @herbrine8403 @yitenchen123
• 补全简体中文缺失的文本,并同步 Crowdin @herbrine8403
• 改进构建与打包流程:双版本运行库、复用已编译组件、构建日志更清晰 @yiyeshi0-hash @yitenchen123
• 其他内容请前往 Commit 界面查看

注意事项

若要在 Minecraft 26.3 上使用 Vulkan,请把渲染器选为 Zink,同时把渲染 API 改为 Vulkan。

Air 5.1.0

This update is mainly about Minecraft 26.3 support and fixes several issues including JIT startup crashes;
it also adds an AI assistant and an automatic update check on launch. Both 26.2 and 26.3 work fine.

Changelog
• Added an AI assistant: chat with it, let it find and install mods / modpacks / shaders, and let it read game logs and explain crashes @herbrine8403
• Added an automatic update check on launch: you get notified when a new version is out, with scrollable release notes @yitenchen123
• Added Minecraft 26.3 support (SDL3 window / input / presentation): fixed the black screen on entering a world, the picture stuck in a corner, having to change the resolution once to get a picture, wrong display in small windows, frame rate always showing 0 with Vulkan, resolution switching not working, the on-screen keyboard and control buttons not typing, the inventory not being clickable, and wrong hotbar keys @yitenchen123 @Gsjsjzhznsz @herbrine8403
• Fixed why the MobileGlues renderer crashed on 26.3: a render hook mistook itself for the real implementation and kept calling itself until it crashed @yiyeshi0-hash
• Added Metal (metallum) renderer support for Minecraft 26.2 / 26.3 @yiyeshi0-hash
• Added the MobileGL / MobileGL-gles renderers, and SimpleFPEWrapper (sfpew) to support 1.17 and below (enable sfpew in the settings and pick MobileGL-gles as the renderer); also fixed MobileGlues crashes and black screens on 26.3 @yitenchen123
• Upgraded the built-in MobileGlues sources to upstream 2.0.x; the shader conversion chain no longer interferes with itself @yitenchen123
• Added two sets of LWJGL runtime libraries (3.3.3 / 3.4.1), picked automatically by game version @yitenchen123
• Fixed Forge / NeoForge direct install issues: launcher being closed during install, crash right after install, and module conflicts @yiyeshi0-hash @yitenchen123
• Fixed OptiFine direct install, modpack import, and download source / mirror errors @yitenchen123
• Fixed JIT issues: enabling JIT (including using an external JIT) no longer crashes the launcher on start, plus a new JIT tool option @herbrine8403 @yiyeshi0-hash…
